info.name: Festival of Lights - Blessing the Festival

descriptions.notStarted: I promised Hannah I'd return to her once I was rested up. I should head back soon.
descriptions.inProgress: Upon my return, Hannah was joyous, having finished the Altar. She now needs candles to signal the start of the ceremony. I'll have to get 9 candles (she mentioned Horned Mushrooms) and bring them back so the Festival of Lights can begin.
descriptions.completed: I acquired the nine candles and gave them to Hannah. The Festival of Lights has begun!
